title: The SDK gets hands-on with audio and images
summary:
The SDK gained image editing and dedicated audio calls, API keys gained management endpoints, and new Gemini and Discord projects joined the mix.

The SDK gained image editing from source images and moved its audio helper to dedicated speech and music endpoints. Audio now returns binary data instead of the previous chat-based response, so existing callers will need to adjust. Image generation without a specified model now defaults to `zimage`; video duration validation accepts the broader range used by newer models. The README covers the new calls, and insufficient-balance errors no longer trigger retries.

New endpoints let users create, list and revoke API keys, with optional model restrictions, Pollen budgets and expiry dates. The dashboard and device authorization UI gained a Key Management permission option. Account tier review scripts were also reorganized to incorporate usage and request-error data.

Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Preview was added as `gemini-flash-lite-3.1` for paid requests. Wan 2.7 image requests now pass pixel dimensions rather than resolution labels, so requested aspect ratios are preserved. Audio transcription requests without a model now default to Whisper. Claude models moved to Bedrock while keeping `claude-fast`, `claude`, `claude-large` and `claude-legacy` as their primary names; version-based names remain aliases. Service routing was updated after an instance restart, and the API reference was regenerated.

daily.title: Dedicated SDK audio calls
daily.text: Generate speech or music through the SDK's audio helpers, with a music duration option and binary audio responses you can save or convert. The changed response type may require updates to existing callers. [Explore the React SDK](https://react.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Edit images with the SDK
daily.text: Pass a prompt and one or more source image URLs to `imageEdit()` or `editImage()`, then save the result or convert it to base64 or a data URL. [Explore the React SDK](https://react.pollinations.ai).

daily.title: Manage keys through an API
daily.text: Create, list and revoke API keys through `/api/account/keys`, with optional model restrictions, Pollen budgets and expiry dates. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite
daily.text: Use `gemini-flash-lite-3.1` for text responses from text, image or audio input, with support for tools, search and code execution. It is a paid-only model. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-flash-lite-3.1).

daily.title: Multi-model Discord bots
daily.text: A new Discord bot family can answer mentions and DMs using Kimi, Gemini Search, Perplexity Fast, DeepSeek or MiniMax, with recent channel history for context.

daily.title: Opposite Prompt bot
daily.text: This Discord bot uses `claude-large` to turn an image prompt into its semantic opposite, then generates that opposite with `zimage`.
